name: Apple 20W USB-C Power Adapter
shortDescription: Apple's 20W USB-C wall charger for fast charging iPhone and charging iPad. Cable sold separately.
description:
A compact wall charger with one USB-C port and up to 20W output. With a USB-C charge cable it fast-charges iPhone 8 and later; Apple quotes up to 50% battery in around 35 minutes.

It also suits iPad Pro and iPad Air. Only the adapter is in the box, so use it with a USB-C or USB-C to Lightning cable.
highlights: Fast charging for iPhone 8 and later
Also charges iPad Pro and iPad Air
